source_text: Populus solus habitabit et in gentibus non reputabitur. Mysterium ecclesiae a mundo segregatae.
pass_a_gloss: People alone will-dwell and among nations not will-be-reckoned. Mystery of-church from world set-apart.
pass_b_english: [[The people will dwell alone and not be reckoned among the nations >> Bible:Numbers 23:9]] — a mystery of the church set apart from the world.
